title: Operator-owned release boundary
summary: The ship stage MUST complete local release preparation and leave remote release actions to the operator.
instructions: The release packet MUST confirm that prior gates are satisfied by current evidence or explicit operator acceptance and waiver directives.

The release packet MUST enumerate active operator gate waivers, deferred acceptance criteria, reviewer criterion amendments, and linked spotfix cases rather than describing waived gates or amended criteria as ordinary passes.
The release packet MUST include rollback guidance, unresolved non-blocking risks, and a concise change summary.
For Pancreator self-development only, the release steward MUST update release metadata under VERSION-001 before operator approval. Embedded target workflows MUST remain release-metadata read-only.
Self-development ship with a managed worktree MUST checkpoint eligible changes, fetch main, rebase, create the release commit, and create the release-index commit.
The workflow MUST create final PR copy after all local commits in the same managed worktree.
The workflow MUST pause for operator approval before branch push, pull-request creation, merge, publication, or deployment.
When away mode enables `approve`, a successful ship packet MAY receive deterministic approval.
Deterministic approval MUST apply only the recorded outcome and terminal workflow transition.
An away-mode ship approval MUST NOT authorize push, pull-request creation, merge, publication, deployment, or branch deletion.

The release steward MUST review the run governance/artifact diagnostics index, repair safe runtime-only defects, record a disposition for every issue, and continue when no legitimate implementation, test, security, or release concern remains. Governance/artifact defects MUST never transition back to implementation; a legitimate concern MUST pause for operator decision.
Before operator approval, the release data, waiver and follow-up disclosure, diff-grounded change list, and referenced release packet MUST run their resolved policy-bound validators under VALID-001.
